titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 102: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 102. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The manuscript page number ⲣⲃ (top left, even page) with a bar above and below as the frame (no strokes). Running title > · ⲛⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲁⲓⲟⲛ · < with its ornaments, no stroke over ⲛ (4×). Every dot run was counted from the dot x-positions. Every ϣ on the page was checked at 5–6× (one sheet): only 16 ϣⲱ has a dot in the lower bowl; all have their tail. ⲯ in ⲙⲯⲩⲭⲁⲩⲉ (l. 2): arms curving upwards and a stem through the baseline (8×), against the straight ϯ of ⲉⲓⲙⲏϯ (l. 9). Kephalaion 38 (opened 89.18) ends at l. 12 with the end mark `:—`; kephalaion 39 opens at l. 13.
